implementation: build_operation_impact_report@contract-impact-operation-v1+thrift (the operation Impact report, released for exact Thrift endpoints)

requires.released_recipe: phebs.thrift.caller.go (thrift-contract@1.2.0 plus thrift-caller@1.6.0-released.1), the running extractors, claim 1.2.0

admission: Admitted only through a verified signed selection beside the current released Thrift Caller Map recipe; an experimental Thrift caller generation never backs it.

surfaces.ui: /impact?shape=operation_callers&protocol=thrift (reached from a Thrift operation in Contract Atlas or Caller Map)
surfaces.http: Existing authenticated /api/operation_impact_report with shape=operation_callers and protocol=thrift

refused: protobuf unless phebs.contract.impact.operation is also released (400)

excluded: field references, proposed change, implementations, WIRE verdict, matching syntactic calls and saved reports (not_in_supported_shape)
Kitex / fbthrift generated clients, and thriftrw/YARPC clients whose committed .thrift has a different SHA-1 (not resolved by the Thrift Caller Map)
runtime impact, completeness and retirement safety
limits: Existing operation report, Caller Map, request and citation bounds; no ceiling widened; no new measured capacity or SLO.
